common_name: Encore Autumn Debutante Azalea (Reblooming Orchid-Pink Double Azalea)

planting.note: Plant container shrubs in spring or fall in moist, well-drained, acidic (pH 4.5–6.0), humus-rich soil in partial shade with at least 4 hours of direct sun for reliable rebloom.

directions: Plant in moist, well-drained, acidic (pH 4.5–6.0), humus-rich soil in partial shade with 4–6 hours of direct sun for best rebloom. Autumn Debutante was one of the original Encore azalea introductions, producing full, double, orchid-pink flowers in a heavy spring flush with recurring bloom in summer and fall — a soft, romantic color and ruffled double form that has made it one of the most enduringly popular cultivars in the Encore line since its release. Its compact, rounded habit suits foundation plantings, borders, and large containers. Like all Encore azaleas, it needs more direct sun than traditional azaleas for dependable fall rebloom. Fertilize with an acid-based fertilizer after the spring flush to support subsequent bloom cycles.

Autumn Ivory produces clean, pure white, single to semi-double flowers in a heavy spring flush with recurring bloom in summer and fall, one of the few dependably white-flowered cultivars in the reblooming Encore line. Its crisp white color makes it a versatile companion for the many pink-, red-, and purple-flowered Encore selections, brightening shaded borders and pairing well with darker-foliaged shrubs. Like all Encore azaleas, it needs more direct sun than traditional azaleas for dependable fall rebloom. Fertilize with an acid-based fertilizer after the spring flush to support subsequent bloom cycles.
